topic: Living and Nonliving Things in Environments
key_concepts: An environment contains living things such as plants and animals.
Living things in a nearby environment can be observed and recorded.
Nonliving things in a land environment include rocks, soil, water, rain, and sunlight.
Soil is important for plants and animals.
Water helps plants and animals survive.
A farm is a land environment with living and nonliving things.
A pond is a water environment that contains living and nonliving things.
Water plants and animals depend on nonliving things in the pond.
Plants and animals depend on each other and on their environment.
Butterflies and flowering plants depend on each other to survive.
